result.topic_en: A printed receipt form, filled in by hand, recording that Professor Dr Riemann received twenty thalers in gold as a partial payment of lecture fees (Honorar) in Göttingen on 15 May 1858, signed by Riemann.
result.transcription:
30
Herr Professor Dr Riemann
erhalten an eingegangenem Honorar abschläglich die Summe
von Zwanzig Thaler Gold
Göttingen den 15ten Mai 1858
B. Riemann.
